Anonymous checkout quote for one 8 × 250 g multipack (2 kg) on 2026-10-12, re-checked in a fresh cart at 20:07 UTC: ₪20 home courier and ₪20 distribution-center delivery up to 5 kg; self-pickup free. The product page publishes no courier price, and carts above 2 kg are not verified.

evidence.note: Anonymous checkout estimator quote recorded by interactive browser research; see docs/evidence/browser-research/2026-10-12-vendor-shipping-quotes.json.

shipping.coverageCaveat: Home delivery is limited to the localities on Amigo’s home-delivery list, which the product page does not publish. Confirm the destination at checkout.
